name: The Space Between Us
source:
Two childhood friends. One rooftop. Eight hours of train track.

Rio is leaving at the end of the month — an astronomy program in a city where the sky is actually dark enough to see the whole Milky Way. Tonight, she wants to meet on the roof. Like old times.

[From [url=https://mmga-project.itch.io/the-space-between-us]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个青梅竹马。一处天台。八小时车程的铁轨。

莉绪月底就要离开了——她要去另一座城市参加天文学项目，那里的夜空足够深邃，能将整条银河尽收眼底。今晚，她想在天台见一面。就像从前那样。

[摘自[url=https://mmga-project.itch.io/the-space-between-us]itch.io[/url]]
